items.name: Turn off hard disk after
items.description: Turn off hard disk after controls I/O link power management.
items.shortDescription: Turn off hard disk after controls I/O link power management.
items.longDescription: Adjusts turn off hard disk after through I/O link power management. Performance-oriented values reduce ramp delays but increase draw and heat.
items.whatItDoes: Writes and tracks turn off hard disk after so Falcon can apply, verify, and rollback consistently for this policy family.
items.whyGamersCare: It is mostly a power-behavior control and usually has limited direct gaming benefit.
items.fpsImpact: Average FPS impact is generally minimal.
items.latencyImpact: Direct end-to-end latency impact is usually low.
items.powerImpact: Conservative values favor lower power at the cost of responsiveness.
items.heatImpact: Thermal impact is usually modest unless combined with other aggressive settings.
items.stabilityRisk: Medium when changed without hardware-specific validation.
items.recommendedFor: Only for controlled experiments with rollback ready.
items.avoidIf: Avoid if you cannot benchmark changes or need strict OEM-default behavior.
